script_text: Stop! Earth sign Taurus, the stars are screaming at you right now. Venus, your ruling planet, is forming a tense square to Mars in your 7th House of Partnerships, creating friction in your relationships. At the same time, Jupiter trines your 2nd House of Income, promising a surprising financial boost. If you're single, the Mars square urges you to assert your desires, while a Venus‑Neptune sextile in the 5th House of Romance invites a soulful connection. A subtle Venus‑Pluto aspect suggests deep transformation in your affection life. In your 10th House of Career, Saturn's conjunction with the North Node signals a pivotal promotion opportunity, but you must act decisively. A sudden gift of insight arrives from your 9th House of Higher Learning, yet beware of overcommitting in your 6th House of Health as Mercury retrograde may cause miscommunication. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
